Jeppe Launbjerg is a practicing cardiologist based at Hjertelægerne i Hillerød [^src1]. Within the context of Danish cardiovascular healthcare quality development, he serves as a member of the steering group for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) [^src1]. His membership in the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] is recorded in consecutive annual reports, including the 2023 report detailing the database's data foundation and validity, and the 2024 report focusing on the quality development framework and clinical practices for atrial fibrillation treatment [^src1] [^src2].
